headlines.headline: Official practices begin as Florida, Iowa State headline preseason picture with season 40 days out
headlines.detail: Florida returns the nation's best frontcourt after Haugh, Condon and Chinyelu all bypassed the NBA draft; Iowa State climbs behind Tamin Lipsey's return. Roughly 60 seniors still weighing extra-eligibility decisions.

headlines.headline: NBA camps open this week, LeBron set for first public look in Sixers gear at Monday media day
headlines.detail: Media day is Monday Sept. 28, training camp practices open Tuesday. Giannis discusses his move to Miami, Kawhi addresses Toronto; Atlanta's Henri Veesaar out for the season with a torn ACL.

headlines.headline: Cowboys-Ravens Rio game headlines Week 3 slate in NFL's first-ever Brazil matchup
headlines.detail: Baltimore led Dallas 17-13 at halftime at Maracanã Stadium after erasing an early 10-0 deficit; Derrick Henry scored twice on the ground for the Ravens. Game remained in progress as of this brief.

headlines.headline: No. 18 Michigan stunned by Iowa on final-play touchdown in Big Ten opener
headlines.detail: Hank Brown found Reece Vander Zee for a 16-yard score as time expired, 20-19, Iowa's first win over Michigan since 2016. Iowa improved to 4-0; Michigan outgained Iowa 429-285 but lost two red-zone turnovers.
